steps.name: 7-workplace-Gland-retains-home-destination
steps.previewText:
Your sentence and map are sent to the connected provider. Avoid personal identifiers.
Save on this device: on
Your situation

I live in Nyon, I own my home, my child is 8 and I am thinking of moving to Saint-Cergue. I hold a B permit.
I also work in Geneva → Gland ?.

What is the moving person’s citizenship? EU/EFTA

The underlined words are what Apertus understood as your answers. Touch one to propose another value.
Proposal, nothing is applied
With “Gland”: 1 steps would change, 0 would appear, 0 would disappear; 2 still need reassessment; 3 have no declared dependency on the changed input.
Keep my situation
Use this proposal
Application-prepared text
These paths prepare your questions. Suggested sources and their applicability await human review.
I also work in Geneva.
What if I work in Gland but still move to Saint-Cergue?
Ask a question or add a goal
→
